notes: Summer Blast, 10 August 1996 (Part 3 of 3). "Flashfire" Dean Ferris defeats "Rude Dog" Alex Reed to become the NEW TAEWF United States Champion. "Quickstrike" Chris Quigley retains the TAEWF North American Singles Championship over Foolkiller (unminted this pass). The Executioner retains the TAEWF World Heavyweight Championship in a four-way Texas Tornado match over Hercules, Heavy Hauler and Kickboxer (unminted this pass; the bout is narrated on the page). Predates the wing's currently-held February 1997 broadcasts by six months.
